explication: This repository is a curated directory of LLM APIs with permanent free tiers. The principal workflow is: a reader browses the generated README, selects a provider and model, obtains an API key when required, calls the provider endpoint, and receives inference output. `data.json` stores provider records, model metadata, glossary entries, and footnotes; `scripts/generate-readme.js` renders these into `README.md`. Verification scripts are maintenance tooling rather than part of the user-facing runtime, so they are omitted.
